entries.name: High reward tagging programs
entries.regs_verbatim: HIGH REWARD ($100) TAGGING PROGRAMS. The Skeena Fisheries team has multiple ongoing $100 reward tagging programs. It is possible to catch a tagged fish of any species anywhere in the Skeena Region. Reward payments can be received by reporting capture information by call or text to: 250-643-7290. Note: Sockeye, Chinook, Pink, Chum, and Coho are not part of the provincial high reward tagging program and should be reported to the nearest Department of Fisheries and Oceans office.
